Faults:
Roll pitch
stabilization issue for
the single Axis servo
Corrective action:
Observe the Servo link
status to be in green color in
EA window of SCD. Check
all the servo related cables
should be connected
properly.

Check the Stow lock lever is
in released condition. Else,
do the necessary
maintenance activity on 1-
Axis servo

Disengage the stow locks,
Emergency switches and
verify the links.

Possible Cause:
Might be switched on in
maintenance mode
Corrective action:
Put the mode switch in
AUTO mode

Possible Cause:
2- axis SDA cables
might not connected
Corrective action:
Check the cable connectivity
of the SDA to SCU cables

Monitor the input
temperature reading at
display HEU and check
temperature 20º  2º at
temperature sensor if it is
not equal to specified value
replace the temperature
sensor.

Replace the pressure
sensor after checking outlet
water flow in good condition.
